title: The DeParis show closes in Charlotte; winter back in Warren
summary: The show closed in Charlotte in November 1925; the three went home and Phillips ran a six-piece band around Arkansas that winter.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: It was in Baltimore you joined them, right?
Yeah. That's where I joined the show, but the show traveled around. We went everywhere, you know. We traveled around... That show closed in Charlotte, North Carolina.
You joined them in the beginning of 1925, right?
What part of the year was it when it closed?
In November, in Charlotte. Then me, Pete and James, we went home -- we went back home.
Pete Jones, James Clark and you.
Now, that was back to Warren.
Yeah, we went back to Warren. So we stayed around there all the winter, and I got a little band together. We had about six pieces.
This is the winter between 1925 and 1926.
Yeah. We used to gig around all through Arkansas and all around through there. Then, when the Spring came again, we was going with another show called The Great
